questions.question: Which tennis star defeated Alexander Zverev to claim his first singles title at the ATP Finals?
questions.explanation: Spanish player Carlos Alcaraz won his maiden ATP Finals singles title with a straight-sets victory in the final.
questions.context: 2026 ATP Finals: In tennis, Carlos Alcaraz defeats Alexander Zverev in the final, 6–2, 7–6 to win his first singles title at the 2026 ATP Finals.

questions.question: Security forces in Bangladesh deployed drones and body cameras across several districts to monitor key sites during unrest in which sector?
questions.explanation: Border Guard Bangladesh stepped up surveillance near industrial zones following demonstrations by garment factory employees.
questions.context: 2026 Bangladesh garment workers protests: Border Guard Bangladesh deploys 95 platoons across seven districts, including two battalions in Gopalganj, stepping up surveillance at key installations and industrial zones using drones and police body cameras.

questions.question: The UN Climate Change Conference COP31 ended without a final agreement after delegates failed to reach a consensus on which major issue?
questions.explanation: COP31 became the longest climate summit on record after participating nations were unable to agree on policy regarding fossil fuels.
questions.context: 2026 United Nations Climate Change Conference: The 2026 United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP31) in Antalya, Turkey, concludes without a final agreement after countries failed to reach consensus on fossil fuel policies. It is the longest climate summit on record.

questions.question: The education minister of which nation stepped down after public backlash over AI-assisted cheating during university entrance exams?
questions.explanation: Choi Kyo-jin offered his resignation, which was accepted by President Lee Jae Myung, following controversy over cheating on the College Scholastic Ability Test.
questions.context: South Korean education minister Choi Kyo-jin resigns following criticism of the government's response to artificial intelligence-assisted cheating concerns surrounding the College Scholastic Ability Test. President Lee Jae Myung accepts Choi's resignation.

questions.question: A merchant vessel flying the flag of which Mediterranean island nation was hit by sea drones off the Libyan coast?
questions.explanation: A Maltese-flagged boat was struck by maritime drones in international waters near Benghazi.
questions.context: Russo-Ukrainian war > Naval warfare in the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present), Ukrainian attacks on the Russian shadow fleet: A Maltese-flagged ship is also struck by naval drones off the coast of Benghazi.
